decision: Keep schemaVersion 1 with optional ShiftTemplate.daysOfWeek and Staff.unavailableDays
reasoning: Zero migration risk for existing MVP localStorage schedules; undefined defaults to [0..6] and []

decision: Confirmed atomic cascade delete when disabling shift days with existing regular or pinned assignments
reasoning: Matches existing previewDeleteShift (E-08) UX and prevents orphan assignments on inactive shift days
rejected: Block disabling day until Manager manually deletes every assignment

decision: Exclude staff with unavailableDays.length === 7 from eligibleStaff and Jain Fairness Index denominator
reasoning: Functionally identical to maxWeeklyHours === 0; prevents artificial Jain Index drop
rejected: Include 7-day-off staff in Jain Index denominator

decision: Only Pinned assignments on unavailable days block Auto-schedule via UNAVAILABLE_DAY Pin Conflict Gate; unpinned are cleared and re-scheduled
reasoning: Consistent with Auto-schedule clearing all unpinned assignments before Stage 1
rejected: Block Auto-schedule on unpinned unavailable-day overrides

decision: Keep Demo Store seed data unchanged in Phase 2
reasoning: Backward-compatible at schemaVersion 1 without scope creep
rejected: Mutate Demo Store seed with weekend shifts

decision: Omit default [0..6]/[] arrays on write; reject malformed day arrays and persisted assignments on inactive shift days as CORRUPT_SCHEMA
reasoning: Preserves MVP snapshot parity and routes illegal persisted payloads to safe recovery_locked backup
rejected: Silent orphan strip on inactive-day assignments or always storing full arrays

decision: Separate immutable shiftDayMask & unavailableMask Uint8Arrays in SchedulerWorkingState; share buildCellCoverableGrid(shifts) in hardRules.ts
reasoning: O(1) hot-loop checks, prevents Stage 2 dayOccupied mutation from erasing days off, eliminates 7x16 index drift
rejected: Merge unavailableDays into mutable dayOccupied or duplicate 2D coverable loops

decision: Centralize isStaffEligible (utilization=null when ineligible) and guard assignStaffToShift, Undo restoreAssignmentsSnapshot, and gapSlots
reasoning: Prevents Ctrl+Z ghost assignments on disabled days and keeps Health Bar, Rebalance Lens, and Diagnostics aligned
rejected: Check eligibility only in solver and inactive days only in UI

decision: Create shared src/ui/common/WeekdayToggleGroup.tsx using canonical English DAY_LABELS (Mon-Sun, Off: Wed, Sun)
reasoning: Zero duplicated toggle UI and 100% consistency with existing English WeeklyRosterGrid and StaffPanel
rejected: Hardcode Vietnamese T2-CN labels mixed into English UI

decision: Implemented T1-T12 across domain/persistence/state/UI with immutable shiftDayMask/unavailableMask bitmasks, shared buildCellCoverableGrid, and WeekdayToggleGroup; added data-inactive-cell/data-reason-code attrs for UI tests
reasoning: Matches ADR-001..004 verbatim, 51/51 tests pass (90.59% coverage), worst-case 50-staff bench 31.27ms
rejected: Mutating dayOccupied in-place or coupling UI tests to Tailwind classes

decision: Added O(1) MRV priority (fewest configured available days via 7-bit popcount) before Best-Fit slack in Stage 1 pickBestFitStaff per user Option 1; kept Jain formula unchanged
reasoning: Prevents scarcity blindness (e.g., preserves 7-day staff for weekends) with 0% MVP regression; 53/53 tests pass
rejected: Changing Jain denominator to effectiveMaxHours in Phase 2 (deferred to separate UX/spec change)
